notes: Source entity: כלל פנסיה וגמל בע"מ (the managing company, wholly owned by כלל חברה לביטוח, itself held by the listed כלל החזקות עסקי ביטוח). All figures come from the managing company's own reports, published on clalbit.co.il (אודות קבוצת כלל > נתונים ומידע, דוחות כספיים > company 'כלל פנסיה וגמל'); MAYA and the parent's reports were not used (the managing company does not report on MAYA). Each fact carries 'doc' (board = דוח הדירקטוריון, biz = דוח תיאור עסקי התאגיד, fs = דוחות כספיים) and the 1-based PDF page of that document.

The report prints the two new pension funds in separate columns (fund_type) and the provident products in four separate columns plus a 'סך הכל' column covering all of them; no pension-only or provident-only subtotal is printed. Nothing was added up: segment pension_new = fund_type מקיפות + כלליות, segment provident = the four provident fund_types (קופות גמל אישיות לתגמולים ופיצויים, קרנות השתלמות, קופת גמל להשקעה, קופות מרכזיות), segment total = the printed 'סך הכל' column. Operating-segments-note facts (table = operating segments note) are the company's own split into pension (segment pension_new) and provident (segment provident, which includes the provident funds the company manages for its parent), the adjustments column (segment 'other') and the total.

Windows: the fund-type table header prints only 'ליום <date>'. Balance items are instant; flows are cumulative from 1 January: three months in Q1 reports (window q), six/nine months in Q2/Q3 reports (window ytd), a full year in FY reports and in the 31 December comparatives (window fy). Each report prints a prior-year-period set and a prior-year-end set; both are included with their own dates (the FY report prints 31 Dec 2025, 2024 and 2023).

Units: amounts in NIS thousands as printed; members in counts (pension: members; gemel: member accounts); fee rates in percent. Fee rates in the fund-type table are printed separately for active members, inactive members and pension recipients (member_status), with no printed blended rate; the FY financial statements (note 18ב) print blended average rates for the two pension funds (member_status total). aum with member_status total is the total net assets row (includes pension recipients), active/inactive are the rows above it (exclude recipients).

Figures are as printed in each report; a later report may restate a comparative (for example IFRS 9 reclassification of investment income, rounding of ±1, small restatements of active/inactive AUM split and member counts at 31 Dec 2025); the differences are not reconciled here.
